podcast.body: Released as the first single from Kings of Leon's second album, "Aha Shake Heartbreak," this song achieved chart success by hitting number 16 on the British singles charts. It was one of three singles from the album that reached the UK Top 20. The song's narrative is rooted in a personal situation experienced by Caleb Followill, who was 17 years old at the time the events inspiring the song unfolded. "The first single was a track called The Bucket."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Kings of Leon in Their Own Words: Part 1

podcast.body: This song received a remix by CSS, which was noted for being a complete reinterpretation that contained none of the original music. This approach aligned with the band's preference for remixes that offer a "completely different" take on their material. "They totally did their own interpretation of it too. Like it's none of the original music was."
